text:
olivia: Quick check 1: launch blog + press outreach tomorrow morning. Embargo currently 06:30 PT. Need final press pack link, CEO soundbite, and confirmation on syndication tiers.
jordan: Pack uploaded: https://redwood.docs/press/bench-sprint.zip. Updated chart captions; removed an absolute claims line per legal.
elena: Noted. Legal flagged one image alt-text; fixed. Also added a short FAQ for reporters in /press/faq.txt.
mike: Social plan draft below. Also want guidance on boosted posts window (first 2 hours?) and US/APAC pacing.
``` 
06:30 PT - Blog live (link)
06:35 PT - Email + tier-1 outreach
06:40 PT - CEO 1-line (X, LinkedIn)
07:00 PT - Short explainer thread
08:00 PT - Syndication wave 2
```
mike: Suggest we hold paid promotion until 30m after publish to avoid promo hitting embargo-sensitive reporters. Thoughts?
legal_bot: Legal: cannot share raw run-level CSVs without NDA. Redacted aggregates ok; NDA flow in pack. Also advise: avoid "guarantee" language in CEO opening.
jordan: Syndication: yep, we'll stagger. Tier-1 (trade), tier-2 (general tech), partners list at +40m. Need a partner blurb for syndication - who drafts?
elena: I can draft the partner blurb. Keep it 1-2 sentences and point to the methodology.
mike: Also a minor amendment request: one benchmark table changed after a rounding fix. If that affects headline numbers we'll use fallback headline in the pack.
olivia: Good call. Jordan, can press outreach wait until I confirm final numbers at 05:45 PT?
jordan: Yes, we'll queue but hold send until your green. Pressbot will show hold status.
pressbot: Outreach job queued; status: pending_hold. Reminder triggers at 05:50 PT and 06:20 PT.
mike: Who's owning replies in first hour? I'll take social; Elena and Olivia handle reporter DMs.
elena: I'll triage DMs and escalate any raw-data asks to legal_bot.
legal_bot: Confirmed. Raw data -> legal review and NDA. Public redacted CSVs available post-NDA.
jordan: One reporter (TechBrief) requested an interview window 07:15-07:30 PT. Olivia, can CEO do 07:20?
olivia: CEO ok for 07:20 but prefers prepped Qs. Please send suggested Qs by 05:30 PT and include the short opener.
mike: I'll pin a 2-line safe opener in the pack under /scripts/ceo_opening.txt. Avoid absolutes.
elena: Ops note: will tag any chart updates with a change-log entry so press knows if numbers shifted.
jordan: Also partner syndication: a few partners asked for a co-branded snippet. We need legal signoff.
legal_bot: Partners co-brand requires partner contract clause; if absent, provide unbranded snippet only.
mike: Contingency: if embargo shifts earlier, we delay paid posts and syndication; if it shifts later we can open paid at +30m.
olivia: OK. Please react with :thumbsup: if you own your piece.
mike: :thumbsup:
elena: :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
pressbot: Reminder: embargo meta: `embargo: 2026-07-14T13:30:00Z` recorded in pack.
olivia: Thanks. I'll lock numbers at 05:45 PT and post an update here. If anything changes after that, we'll do a short update to the pack and ping this channel.
